title: remaining gaps in ADDR_CANON_FR
headline: ADDR_CANON_FR has no material gap left. The French function-word finding is real but ~37.5% smaller than established, and its stated mechanism (IDF dilution, blocking harm) is measurably weak to non-existent.
new_defect: normalize.py:333-335 matches a whole comma-component against FR_REGIONS then 'continue's, so the de/la of 'Pays de la Loire', 'Hauts de France', 'Pas de Calais' and 'Ile de France' never reach atoks. The established 16.40% France function-word share is therefore inflated by ~37.5%.

function_word_finding.verdict: CONFIRMED unhandled, but MAGNITUDE CORRECTED and MECHANISM MISDIAGNOSED. Recommend AGAINST adding to ADDR_CANON_FR.

region_consumption_arithmetic.method: size each FR_REGIONS key by its rarest constituent, since a component match requires all its words

function_word_finding.bound_note: 527997/209310 are UPPER bounds on consumption, so pipeline-visible share is a RANGE [10.25%, 16.40%], point estimate 10.25%. Not an exact figure.
function_word_finding.second_order: non-de/la FR_REGIONS component tokens total 2205764, so the profile denominator is also inflated; both corrections push the true share in the same direction.

idf_bound.formula: idf = ln(n/df) per (country,tok), n = 1694445 France rows, df <= occurrences
idf_bound.conclusion: de already carries at most 0.4785/13.244 = 3.6% of a rare token's weight. The 'dilutes IDF' rationale is largely self-neutralised.

blocking_analysis.source_lines: keys.py:39 filters ADDR_GENERIC; keys.py:42 requires len>=3 for alph tokens; S1_MAXCAP=300 at keys.py:26
blocking_analysis.conclusion: ALL SIX are already inert for candidate generation. Adding them buys ZERO recall. The 'blocking caps are healthy' finding is unaffected.

collision_risk.work_order_example: Rue de la Paix vs Rue de la Reine
collision_risk.response: Not a real risk: deleting de/la leaves rue paix vs rue reine, still distinct. The discriminating token is the odonym name, which always survives.
collision_risk.why_low: normalize.py:342 removes apostrophes, so l'Eglise -> leglise; most French articles are elided into the following word

function_word_finding.surviving_justification: Unweighted a_len/a_inter/a_jac/a_cont (features.py:112,123-124) and a_ratio/a_tsort/a_tset/a_partial (features.py:83-86) ARE compressed. Worked example: {rue,de,la,paix,bordeaux} vs {rue,de,la,liberation,bordeaux} gives a_cont 4/5=0.800 for a non-match; after deletion 2/3=0.667, while a true match stays 1.000. Real but UNMEASUREED in effect - no pair data in profile.
function_word_finding.final_recommendation: DECLINED for ADDR_CANON_FR. Correct home is a stopword filter on the atoks string in features.py and stage2.py, not 6 entries in a street-type table.

street_type_gaps.note: All counts are s1+s2+s3 from addr_tokens.France, top 4000 only. Absence means NOT IN THE TOP 4000, never 'does not occur'.

teste.is: La Teste-de-Buch, a commune near Bordeaux

not_street_types_do_not_add.evidence: near-exact pairing teste 72268 vs buch 72331 and cap 61600 vs ferret 60275 is the signature of hyphenated compounds split by TOKEN_RE=[a-z0-9]+ at build_profile.py:28. The pipeline also splits them (it strips accents at normalize.py:317, not hyphens), so these are real pipeline tokens - but they are place names.
not_street_types_do_not_add.headline: teste + cap = 133868 = 1.116% of listed mass, LARGER than the entire Group A + Group B street-type gap (66449 = 0.554%) combined.

tokenizer_mismatch.mechanism: build_profile.py:28 tokenises the RAW address; normalize.py:317 applies strip_accents FIRST. Accents are separators in the profile and removed in the pipeline.
tokenizer_mismatch.consequence: chaussee is the worst-sized Group A candidate: 3.1x undercount. Practical rule: treat any candidate evidenced by a token of 4 characters or fewer as unverified.

per_source_form_stability.s2_over_s3_ratio_range: 0.86-1.08 for every Group A/B candidate, so the written form is stable across query sources
per_source_form_stability.s1_over_s2_ratio: uniformly ~0.41, a ROW-COUNT artefact (259452/703378 = 0.369), NOT a form change
per_source_form_stability.exceptions: chaussee s1/s2 = 0.138 and cite 0.117, low because their fragments chauss/cit concentrate in s1

ranked_recommendations.evidence: cour 9403 unhandled vs cours 8761 -> crs handled; the long form is mapped, the abbreviation is not

ranked_recommendations.proposal: Add self-maps: passage, lotissement, hameau, esplanade, sentier, ruelle, parvis, venelle, mail, allees, passerelle, rond
Add chaussee:chaussee but re-derive its size after fixing build_profile.py

ranked_recommendations.evidence: Group A but each is also a common noun

ranked_recommendations.proposal: Group B: parc, pont, port, cite, gare, villa, campus etc
ranked_recommendations.evidence: noun sense dominates for several; moulin/fontaine/jardin are name elements

ranked_recommendations.proposal: DO NOT add de/la/le/les to ADDR_CANON_FR
ranked_recommendations.evidence: IDF already discounts them ~28x, they cannot reach blocking at all, and la/le/les carry an article-collision class of 15609 tokens (0.13%)

ranked_recommendations.proposal: DO NOT add teste, buch, cap, ferret, moulin, fontaine, jardin, chateau, canal, maine, or any animal/colour noun
ranked_recommendations.evidence: place names, name elements, or shared with US/India

ranked_recommendations.proposal: Fix build_profile.py:28 to apply strip_accents before findall
ranked_recommendations.evidence: corrects chauss/cit/ch/galit/col and re-sizes every short token; prerequisite for trusting future mining of this table

ranked_recommendations.proposal: Add a state_resolved per-country counter to the profile builder
ranked_recommendations.evidence: would have made section 1 exact instead of a range

no_change_needed.rationale: inert, zero cost, and they make the table look complete. Do not delete: churn for no measurable gain.

gaps_and_limits: No pair-level data in the profile, so the effect of function-word deletion on a_cont/a_jac cannot be measured. This is why recommendation 6 is declined rather than promoted.
The section 1 region-consumption figures are upper bounds, so the pipeline-visible function-word share is a RANGE [10.25%, 16.40%], not a point.
Component boundaries are destroyed by build_profile.py:126; region-component consumption is inferred from token co-occurrence, not observed directly.
Street-type vs noun sense is not decidable from token counts; the Group A/B split is linguistic judgement, marked as such.
addr_tokens is the top 4000 per country per file and build_profile.py:130-133 prunes hapax tokens, so no 'does not occur' claim is made anywhere.
Train-side France is unmeasurable: by_country.France.rows = 0 in all three train files.
No raw *.tsv was opened and no network was used. All figures come from analysis_out/profile/test_s{1,2,3}.json or quoted lines of _upstream/src/*.py.

cross_check_against_already_checked.REFUTED_1_french_postcodes: not re-derived; this task does not touch pin. No claim either way.
cross_check_against_already_checked.REFUTED_2_FR_REGIONS_coverage: not re-derived; NO France-wide state-resolution rate is quoted. FR_REGIONS is used only to establish which tokens are discarded before tokenisation, which is a statement about normalize.py:333-335, not about region adequacy. The 71.10%/97.44% dispute is untouched and remains open.
cross_check_against_already_checked.function_word_finding: direction CONFIRMED, magnitude CORRECTED (16.40% -> ~10.25% pipeline-visible), mechanism MISDIAGNOSED (IDF weak, blocking nil).
cross_check_against_already_checked.ADDR_CANON_COMMON: not audited; a02 owns it. Only cross-dictionary fact relied on is the overlay {**COMMON-7, **FR} at normalize.py:321.
